title: Map — give me buttons html file

messages.content:
give me buttons html file

(Answering inside the brain-map view: mention the exact repo-relative paths of every relevant file so the map can highlight them.)

Done. Created `crs-brain/data/docs/buttons.html` — a self-contained button showcase (open/click it to render).

It mirrors the locked spec in `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html` §3 and pulls its values from `design/tokens.css`:
- **Variants**: primary, secondary, danger, ghost, link
- **Sizes**: sm 28px / default 32px / lg 40px
- **Icon buttons** and **disabled** states

Active states change background + text only (no border), per the rules in `CLAUDE.md`. If you'd rather I point buttons at a live `tokens.css` `<link>` instead of inlining the values, say so — I inlined them so the file renders standalone.
